assets.caption: Seed and sprout, pictured as a material analogy.

assets.caption: The saying notices timing; the illustration leaves the reason open.

Resting/standing contrast does not establish feigning; reason explicitly left open. Period-like clothing is an invented scene choice, not historical evidence.
